crossRefs.note: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?
The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters: but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be…
At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A hot wind from the bare heights in the wilderness…
a full wind from these will come for me. Now I will also utter judgments against them.”
A third part you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled. You shall…
The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.
Therefore they will be like the morning mist, and like the dew that passes away early, like the chaff that is driven…
He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

translations.web: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.
translations.bsb: You snatch me up into the wind and drive me before it; You toss me about in the storm.
translations.kjv: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride upon it, and dissolvest my substance.
translations.asv: Thou liftest me up to the wind, thou causest me to ride upon it; And thou dissolvest me in the storm.
